{{Quote|Meet me on Lok. I happen to have a place not too far from this secret laboratory. Should be great for a staging area.|[[Cale Herron]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TP" />}}
'''Cale's Lok Outpost''' was a small outpost operated by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Cale Herron]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I have all the equipment here to monitor the location remotely. If someone comes within 1000 meters I'll be the early warning system.|Cale Herron, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TP" />}}
[[File:CalesLokOutpostMountain-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cale's Lok Outpost, on a mountain capped by a Jedi shrine.]]
The outpost, situated on a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], capped with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] shrine, was located between the [[Westerly]] region and [[Nym Protectorate]].<ref name="SWG:TP" />

[[File:CaleHerronLokOutpost-SWG.jpg|200px|thumb|Cale Herron, standing inside his outpost.]]
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the scentist [[Derg Prantis]] has established a [[Secret Laboratory|secret laboratory]] to conduct research on the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]]. However, Prantis was finally betrayed by his lab assistant, [[Bera Jeza]], who contacted the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to sell him the virus. Having discovered the betrayal, Derg Prantis requested his long time associate Cale Herron to help him evacuate the secret lab and destroy evidence from his near outpost. After the scientist was assassinated, Cale Herron and a spacer came to Lok and worked together from the outpost to investigate Prantis' secret lab.<ref name="SWG:TP" /> The investigation finally led to the discovery of a [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|Blackwing virus outbreak]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cale's Lok outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The outpost was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This location was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:TP" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
